capabilities: Transform pasted GitHub links into tags showing issue and pull request titles and statuses
Embed tables of GitHub data using github-query codeblocks
Refresh query result tables when a note is opened
extras: README defers details to external documentation and mentions a changelog that follows semantic versioning.
problem: GitHub links pasted into notes are bare and give no information about the referenced issue or pull request.
summary: Plugin that enriches notes with GitHub content by turning GitHub links into status tags and embedding query result tables via codeblocks.
